blocks.content: Insider trading refers to buying or selling securities using unpublished price-sensitive information. SEBI strictly prohibits such practices.
Insider trading refers to buying or selling securities using unpublished price-sensitive information.

items: SEBI is the regulatory body that strictly prohibits insider trading.
Using unpublished price-sensitive information to trade securities constitutes illegal insider trading.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Insider trading consists of trading securities based on unpublished price-sensitive information.
SEBI strictly prohibits insider trading practices in capital markets.
